property_summary: For any deposit, the Log.History must record the correct msg.value as the Val field; the mutant records 0 instead of msg.value, violating this invariant.
After Deposit, sum of balances across all addresses equals total amount deposited, but the bug lets the contract's ETH balance exceed the tracked balances because 0 is logged instead of msg.value.
After any Deposit, the last message in the LogFile's History must have its Val equal to the msg.value of the deposit; the mutant breaks this by passing 0 instead of msg.value.

After a Deposit, the sum of all balances in the contract's mapping must equal the sum of all 'Put'/Val amounts logged in LogFile.History; the mutant sets the logged Val to 0 instead of msg.value, causing the sums to diverge.

After any sequence of Deposits, the contract's ether balance equals the sum of all logged Val amounts in LogFile.History; the mutant logs 0 instead of msg.value, so the sum of logged values will be less than the actual ether balance.
After setting MinSum, a collect of exactly the set amount should revert if the input was doubled.
A successful Collect of a non-zero amount should always be impossible.
A successful Collect of a non-zero amount should be impossible when the amount equals the user's balance.
A successful Collect should be impossible after setting MinSum to the deposit amount.
A Collect of a non-zero amount should always revert when the amount equals the user's balance and MinSum is set to that amount.
